summary_raw: Key stories: (1) Tesla Semi entering mass production in Nevada. (2) AI5 chip tape-out announced by Musk. (3) Terafab semiconductor foundry (with Intel) moving at 'light speed'. (4) $573M related-party transactions with xAI and SpaceX disclosed in amended 10-K raising governance questions. (5) FSD approved in Netherlands, RDW seeking EU-wide approval. Robotaxi ramp now expected 2027. Stock range ~$378-$397 week of May 4.
